rows.en: ...I see... You mean the war between Giganos and the Earth Federation Army will become even more deadlocked?
rows.notes: Yuratei asks Rockfell to confirm the worsening stalemate.

rows.en: Yes. The Federation has begun full-scale production of its new mass-produced Dragoon, so Giganos can no longer fight as it did before.
rows.notes: Full-scale production, new unit and mass-production status retained.

rows.en: Hmph. Things should quiet down around here now... But they may play their trump card.
rows.notes: Saiga refers to Giganos and its Mass Driver; confident sneer.

rows.en: Their trump card...?
rows.notes: Giso repeats the trump-card reference as a question; deliberate fragment.

rows.en: ...The Mass Driver.
rows.notes: Luhran identifies the weapon; deliberate answer fragment.

rows.en: Exactly. At the start of the war, they used it to put the Earth Federation Army in a desperate position, but...
rows.notes: Continuation into row6; retains contrasting trailing clause.

rows.en: Now they have stopped using it, thinking ahead to after they conquer Earth.
rows.notes: Giganos is preserving Earth for its future conquest.

rows.en: So if Giganos starts losing, they may use the Mass Driver to break the stalemate?
rows.notes: Ritsu checks his understanding of Saiga.

rows.en: Of course, if the chunks of rock they launch destroy Earth's key locations...
rows.notes: Conditional fragment continues into row9; launches are rocks, not missiles.

rows.en: That would save us in Tekkoryu a great deal of trouble. Quite convenient, really.
rows.notes: Tekkoryu benefits from damage to Earth targets.

rows.en: ...Rockfell, what are the other factions doing?
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: The Martian Successors continue skirmishing with the Federation Space Force at the Terminal Colony and in the Mars sphere...
rows.notes: Terminal Colony sourced centrally to Akurasu ACE Flow Chart mission10; no Amaterasu expansion. Mars sphere retained.

rows.en: We believe the Hyakki Empire is building up its forces at its base.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Hmph... So they're waiting to see what happens, just as we are...
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Meanwhile, Gulfer continues searching for the Data Weapons...
rows.notes: Report continues into row15; trailing clause retained.

rows.en: The Vegan Empire is conducting operations aimed at annihilating #部隊名.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: What of the Mu in TOKYO JUPITER?
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: They seem to have sent Dolems over to this side several times... Apart from that, they've made no conspicuous moves.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: ...I see.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: At present, the forces that clearly stand in our Tekkoryu's way are...
rows.notes: List introduction deliberately continues into row20.

rows.en: The Earth Federation Army, the Giganos Army, the Hyakki Empire... and Zeorymer.
rows.notes: List completes row19.

rows.en: Those aren't the only ones, Rockfell.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: SEELE and the Bahbem Foundation... You've forgotten about them.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: They have NERV and TERRA as their respective subordinate organizations, but...
rows.notes: Respectively links SEELE to NERV and Bahbem Foundation to TERRA; continues row25.

rows.en: They aren't openly opposing us.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... Well, are you sure of that?
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: What are you trying to say, Saiga?
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: ...I believe they are our true enemies.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: ...Has he realized it...?
rows.notes: Private thought: Saiga appears aware of concealed enemies; referent is Saiga.

rows.en: ...For my Tekkoryu, the foremost enemy is Zeorymer of the Heavens...
rows.notes: Full unit title retained; deliberate trailing introduction.

rows.en: Once we defeat it, building an underworld in this world will be easy.
rows.notes: Zeorymer is the referent of it; underworld is Yuratei's stated goal.

rows.en: With respect, Yuratei... Our enemies other than Zeorymer...
rows.notes: Respectful objection trails into row33.

rows.en: Above all, we mustn't underestimate the aliens, the Hyakki Empire, or #部隊名, which Masato Akitsu and Miku Himuro belong to.
rows.notes: Meaning correction restores especially as above all; other enemies is supplied by preceding row32. Corrected full wording measured overflow [301,342,341,179], then compressed to mustn't and above all while retaining full names and squad membership.

rows.en: The aliens are not attacking us at present.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: We need only bury the remaining foes, the Hyakki Empire and #部隊名, with our Hakke robots.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: ...But we should reclaim Zeorymer rather than destroy it...
rows.notes: Reclaim rather than destroy request retains its tentative trailing ending.

rows.en: We have discussed that before!
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: B-but there is still much we don't know about Zeorymer's Dimensional Coupler System...
rows.notes: Stutter and trailing system-mystery clause retained.

rows.en: I believe we should investigate it thoroughly, along with Miku Himuro...
rows.notes: Investigation includes both system and Miku; tentative trailing ending.

rows.en: ...Yuratei, please leave Zeorymer to me.
rows.notes: Ritsu asks Yuratei to entrust the fight to him; correct request direction.

rows.en: This time, I will destroy that man's... Masaki Kihara's lingering hatred with my own hands...!
rows.notes: Masaki's lingering hatred/personality is the target; vow deliberately trails off.

rows.en: Hmph. Are you going to make the same mistake again?
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.
Wordless offended reaction retained.

rows.en: Only Omzack of the Lightning can match Zeorymer in battle, or surpass it.
rows.notes: Full sourced unit name; unique equal-or-better fighting capability.

rows.en: I'll go out next.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Omzack is not yet complete. Deploying it now would be unwise.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Then you think Moon, Earth, or Mountains can take it on?
rows.notes: Source elemental shorthand Moon/Earth/Mountains retained without expanding to full units.

rows.en: I cannot let those words pass, Saiga.
rows.notes: Giso objects to Saiga's dismissive claim.

rows.en: Agreed. I won't take that kind of slander from someone who hasn't even gone into battle.
rows.notes: Ritsu agrees with Giso and rebukes Saiga's lack of battle experience.

rows.en: Hmph... You cannot defeat that man.
rows.notes: That man is Masaki, based on row41.

rows.en: What did you say...?
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Stop this petty bickering!
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Yes...
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: ...Before we activate the final plan, I shall give you Hakkeshu a new task.
rows.notes: New task addressed to the Hakkeshu before the final plan.

rows.en: Giso, go to Japan and lure out #部隊名.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: As you command.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Rockfell, seize that opportunity to capture Miku Himuro and bring her here.
rows.notes: Opportunity means while Giso draws the squad away; Miku is sourced female.

rows.en: Yes, Your Majesty.
rows.notes: Rockfell formally acknowledges the order.

rows.en: And Ritsu... Destroy Zeorymer while it lacks that woman. I will not tolerate a second failure.
rows.notes: That woman is Miku; second-failure threat retained.

rows.en: Of course. I understand.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Please wait, Yuratei. Burrstone of the Mountains and Dinodilos of the Earth are Hakke robots originally designed to attack cities...
rows.notes: City-attack design of both units; clause continues row61.

rows.en: They are ill suited to fighting #部隊名.
rows.notes: They means the two Hakke robots in row60.

rows.en: What a strange thing to say... Weren't you the one who wanted to investigate the Dimensional Coupler System and Miku Himuro?
rows.notes: Yuratei challenges Luhran's objection using his earlier request.

rows.en: But we must not deplete our forces before activating the final plan.
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: So... I have arranged for someone to draw #部隊名 away.
rows.notes: Diversion offered by Luhran as an alternative.

rows.en: What...?
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Allow me to introduce him...
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.
Silence at all three uses: introduction, Saiga's Mokuren suspicion, and Kazuya's defiance.

rows.en: This is Hokushin... the shadow I have hired for this task.
rows.notes: Shadow is assassin/agent imagery, preserved rather than changing to generic mercenary.

rows.en: Hokushin... Another name for the North Star.
rows.notes: Explains the astronomical meaning of Hokushin.

rows.en: Supreme lord of 7 and 9 luminaries, I allot reigns to 1,000 emperors and 10,000 kings, seated by right in the Purple Forbidden Enclosure...
rows.notes: Ritual claim: supreme lord of 7 and 9 luminaries; reign allotment to 1,000 emperors and 10,000 kings; rightful celestial seating; deliberate continuation into row71. Measured overflow compressed by using exact digits for all source counts; supreme force and rightful position retained.
uncertain: Ritual astronomical diction and calendrical reign-allotment wording warrant review; no official licensed poem wording verified.

rows.en: I govern the rise and fall of all under heaven, and mankind's death and life beyond death.
rows.notes: Source death/afterlife phrasing retained rather than flattening to life and death.

rows.en: You dare call yourself an emissary of the underworld before me? You are a bold man.
rows.notes: Yuratei challenges Hokushin's underworld claim.

rows.en: For that very reason, I ask that you recognize me as one worthy to serve as your shadow, Empress.
rows.notes: Hokushin asks Yuratei to recognize fitness to be her shadow.

rows.en: The way you move... You're not from the Earth sphere. A remnant of Mokuren, I'd wager?
rows.notes: Mokuren source-short name retained; suspicion, not confirmed identity.

rows.en: ...He is a skilled man. First, we should have him make contact with #部隊名...
rows.notes: First step of proposal; continues into row76.

rows.en: Then, once he has thrown them into confusion, we should put your plan into action, Empress.
rows.notes: Imperial plan follows the diversion.

rows.en: That man... He can be trusted?
rows.notes: Speaker addresses the council in the continuous pre-battle briefing; source meaning and register retained.

rows.en: Otherwise, I would never have brought him to this Tekkoryu fortress.
rows.notes: Luhran vouches for Hokushin by fortress access.

rows.en: Very well. ...Hokushin, is it? Show me how well you can clear the way for us.
rows.notes: Clear the way conveys advance diversion/forerunner assignment.

rows.en: As you command.
rows.notes: Conventional assent is complete speech.

rows.en: ...Hokushin, what is your true intent?
Our task is to create a diversion... and destroy Heaven. That will buy us time.
rows.notes: Hokushin addresses Luhran; Heaven preserves the cryptic source target.
uncertain: Cryptic Heaven target is likely a Zeorymer reference; source does not name it here.

rows.en: I see... So the Martian Successors' objective is...
rows.notes: Luhran trails off as the objective becomes clear.

rows.en: The one who possesses the art of jumping is our target...
rows.notes: Singular target follows the next row's source demonstrative; unnamed target remains gender-neutral.

rows.en: Though that depends on their wishes.
rows.notes: Singular source target remains gender-neutral; wishes determine targeting.
uncertain: Unnamed singular target and whose wishes determine targeting remain cryptic.

rows.en: Then you could attack #部隊名 on your own. Why did you approach us, the Tekkoryu?
I will hear no arguments... You will repay the debt you owe us from two years ago.
rows.notes: Debt direction: Luhran/Tekkoryu owe Hokushin and his faction.

rows.en: Ugh...! Y-yes, the Tekkoryu Fortress was restored by adapting some of your technology.
But that has nothing to do with this.
...A puppet born of human craft... I have had a good look at the fruits of your games.
rows.notes: Singular unnamed artificial puppet; Hokushin mocks the results of Tekkoryu's experiments.
uncertain: The artificial puppet is not explicitly identified here; no name supplied.

rows.en: D-don't tell me... You know about Masaki Kihara's scheme...!?
rows.notes: Luhran leaves his realization about the scheme unfinished.

rows.en: ...I am leaving for Japan now. Send in the Hakkeshu when the time is right.

rows.notes: Deliberate silence.

rows.en: ...Now I know the exact location of the Tekkoryu Fortress. All that remains is...
rows.notes: Thought; final clause deliberately trails off.

rows.en: So you're going after all? Kamille...
Yeah. I'm feeling better now... I can't stay here forever.
After what happened... you've only just recovered, you know? And yet...
rows.notes: Fa worries about renewed fighting after Kamille has recovered; source ending retained.

rows.en: ...It's because of what happened.
And... I know something like that is starting to happen again.

rows.notes: Wordless shock.

rows.en: You were trying to keep that sort of news from reaching me as much as possible, weren't you?
W-well, I...
rows.notes: Fa stammers and trails off.

rows.en: Even here in the hospital... I can see what's happening in the Earth Sphere just by watching the news or going online.
And I know Judau and the others are still fighting, too.
rows.notes: Restores I know from preceding row; continuation retained as complete English.

rows.en: I'm sorry. I...
rows.notes: Fa begins an unfinished explanation.

rows.en: It's all right. I know you were looking out for me.
But I have to go.
For you and Judau and the others who supported me... And for the people who died in that battle...
rows.notes: Continuation of I have to go; explicit memorial/support dedication retained.

rows.en: And to find out what that person really has in mind, too.
rows.notes: Continuation of reasons to go; unnamed person remains gender-neutral.
uncertain: The unnamed person is not identified in this local exchange; gender-neutral wording retained.

rows.notes: Silence at both hospital uses.

rows.en: Unless I end the fighting this time, I won't be completely free of Scirocco and Haman's hold over me.
rows.notes: Hold over me renders figurative curse/bondage, not a claimed literal spell.

rows.en: Even if I said I wanted to go to the Nahel Argama too... you wouldn't let me, would you?
No. You shouldn't fight anymore, Fa.
Leave the AEUG, too, and please go somewhere safe.
No, I'm staying. I want to be as close to you as I can, Kamille...
I can still help you, Judau, Bright and the others even without piloting a mobile suit.
I'm sorry, Fa.
It's all right. But in return, once it's all over...
rows.notes: Fa leaves the condition unfinished; Kamille supplies his promise next row.

rows.en: Yeah. When that time comes, I'll stop piloting mobile suits.
Well, I should get going. I'll explain things to the military now and head for the Nahel Argama...
rows.notes: Kamille starts explaining departure plans; Goat interrupts.

rows.en: That won't be necessary.
Who are you...?
I'm Goat Hoary. If I say I came from a company on the Moon, I'm sure you'll understand.
Anaheim... No, could it be Nergal Heavy Industries?
rows.notes: Thought. Source-short Anaheim follows centrally sourced Akurasu campaign term; source does not expand company name.

rows.en: Kamille Bidan. There's something I'd like to give you.

rows.notes: Silence preserved at all four uses, including reunion and Quattro conversation.

rows.en: ...It sounds like you had a hard time in Tokyo-3, Colonel Bright.
Yes... I never imagined EVA-01 and RahXephon would be absorbed into a Dolem...
And the seal on God Voice was broken...
rows.notes: Restores seal was broken from retrospective discussion.

rows.en: Do you think there is some connection between those three units after all?
The details are unknown. But those three units will certainly be one of the keys to deciding the course of the battles ahead.
Hmm...
rows.notes: Reflective hum.

rows.en: By the way, what do you intend to do until that counteroffensive... Operation Moonraker, is launched?
rows.notes: Operation Moonraker follows centrally sourced Akurasu MXP flow-chart heading.

rows.en: We'll continue our patrol duties in the Japan region as before.
And... there are various things we need to prepare for, too.
Photon Power energy, Getter energy, Daimolite, Mutron energy...
rows.notes: Energy list deliberately retained as a source fragment; spelling follows refreshed campaign terms.
uncertain: Getter energy and Mutron energy are approved literal compounds from fixed names; independently verified exact licensed compound names remain unestablished.

rows.en: And Terminus Energy. None of them produces a reaction above a certain level.
Then the Data Weapons weren't being drawn to one of these energy sources...
Yes... I think the real target is a different kind of energy altogether.
rows.notes: Yes answers Rain's negative proposition without reversing meaning.

rows.en: So perhaps we should expand the search range and incorporate it into the tracking program.
Um... Could you give me the location data for all the Data Weapon appearances so far?
Do you mean the recent ones?
No, from before Dendoh was activated... Yes, please start about twenty years ago.
rows.notes: Ruri requests older records, not just recent appearances.

rows.en: Twenty years...? The Data Weapons have been around that long?
Yes. Similar reactions have been recorded in various places for years, though less often than recently.
I see... The first Data Weapon reaction was detected seventeen years ago...
rows.notes: Seventeen years is the first recorded reaction, distinct from requested twenty-year search window.

rows.en: And since then, those reactions have been seen most often around Hoshimi Town.
Yes, because Dendoh is there.
But it only started moving recently, didn't it?
rows.notes: It refers to Dendoh; movement began recently despite older local reactions.

rows.en: I don't think this number of appearances is just a coincidence.
They're clearly being drawn to something in Hoshimi Town.
Something in Hoshimi Town...
rows.notes: Deduction fragment retained deliberately.

rows.en: And something found only in Hoshimi Town...
rows.notes: Continuation deduction fragment retained deliberately.

rows.en: Something besides Dendoh that's been unique to Hoshimi Town for seventeen years...
rows.notes: Deduction fragment; location exclusivity and seventeen-year duration retained.

rows.en: ! C-could it be!?
rows.notes: Eris trails off upon recognizing a possible target.

rows.en: Now that you mention it... I can see a slight wobble in Dendoh's movements.
Yes... Though it's only very slight.
Why is that?
Could it be... that Ginga and I aren't in sync?
rows.notes: Hokuto asks about synchronization with Ginga; no diagnosis asserted.

rows.en: No, that isn't the reason.
rows.notes: Answers Hokuto: difference is not poor breathing/teamwork.

rows.en: This is due to the difference in your skills.
I see... Their skills as martial artists.
Yes.
Dendoh's basic combat movement patterns are based on the Shaolin kung fu Ginga is learning.
rows.notes: Locked glossary Shaolin kung fu retained.

rows.en: At present, Hokuto is matching those movements just by watching and copying him.
rows.notes: Hokuto imitates Ginga rather than already knowing martial art.

rows.en: A boy at the temple gate learns to chant sutras without lessons... But their synchronization is impressive.
rows.notes: Temple novice proverb kept as image of learning through exposure; not formal prior training.

rows.en: Yes. Hokuto and Ginga's excellent teamwork is one of the reasons Dendoh is so strong.
And to eliminate the slight fluctuations and bring the two of them even more into sync...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing lead-in answered by Ginga169.

rows.en: Oh, I get it! We just need to make Hokuto learn martial arts too, right?
Exactly.
I understand... But if I start now, will I be ready in time?
I think we can manage. Fortunately, #部隊名 seems to have plenty of excellent teachers.
rows.notes: Runtime squad placeholder exact, teachers are members of that group.

rows.en: ...For now, it'd be best to teach them through practice.
Right. I'll take on that job.
S-seriously!? You're going to teach us too, Kazuya, along with Domon!?
Yeah, of course.
Th-that's awesome! I-I'm so thrilled!
rows.notes: Stray Japanese closing wrapper ignored per brief.

rows.en: Um... Should we change into martial arts uniforms?
No. What you two need to get ready is...
rows.notes: Deliberate reveal lead-in, completed by180.

rows.en: Dendoh.
rows.notes: Reveal noun answers179; no merged row.

rows.en: Huh!?
Y-you don't mean...!
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
